entries.title: Stoicism: What Is in Your Control?
entries.hook: A delayed train tests your stoicism in sixty seconds.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The train is delayed. The weather, the signal, the queue: none of them belong to you.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Your seat choice, your next call, your tone: those are yours.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The test is simple. Name what is yours, and place the rest down.

entries.prompt: What belongs to you in a delay?
entries.visualBrief: Quiet railway platform at golden hour with one adult traveller standing calm apart from the crowd, wide restrained composition, hands out of frame, slate blue and amber palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Small Talk That Does Not Feel Fake
entries.hook: What turns polite noise into real conversation?

turns.speaker: colleague_b
turns.text: It is. I walked from the station and my ears are still explaining why.

turns.speaker: colleague_a
turns.text: That is the difference. Weather first, then one honest detail of your own.

entries.prompt: What makes the reply feel real?
entries.visualBrief: Bright modern office kitchen with two adult colleagues holding mugs near a window, chest-up framing, hands mostly below frame, soft green and cream palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Stoicism: Delay vs Rejection
entries.hook: The reply is late. Which reading is the stoic one?

turns.speaker: friend_a
turns.text: No answer yet. Maybe my message annoyed them.

turns.speaker: friend_b
turns.text: Or their week is full. Late is not the same as no.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: One reading blames you without evidence. The other waits for facts.

entries.answer: Their week may simply be full.
entries.visualBrief: Soft evening living room with an adult man setting a phone face down beside a book, upper body only, hands below frame, muted blue and warm sand palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Small Talk: The Clean Exit Line
entries.hook: Good small talk needs a door, not an escape.

turns.speaker: colleague_a
turns.text: Anyway, I will let you get back to your afternoon.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The summary line closes the talk warmly. No excuse, no vanish, no apology needed.

entries.answer: The summary line and a warm reply.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime office corridor with two adult colleagues ending a friendly chat near a doorway, relaxed posture, upper bodies visible, hands below frame, coral and light blue palette, no readable text.
